common: Square image, 1:1. One single subject, centred, filling about 70% of the square, with even empty margin on every side. A few large, clearly separated shapes and a bold silhouette, so it still reads as a small 96-pixel icon. No text, no letters, no runes, no numbers, no border, no frame, no blood, no gore, no human faces. Medieval low-fantasy world, rough and earthy, nothing modern, nothing shiny or heroic.

woodcut.name: Ксилография
woodcut.text: Style: a woodcut print in black iron-gall ink on plain aged parchment. Thick carved lines, sparse coarse hatching only in the shadows, flat ink, no gradients. Black and parchment only, plus one small muted oxblood-red accent on a single detail.

seal.name: Восковая печать
seal.text: Style: a round dark-red sealing-wax seal seen straight from above, slightly irregular wax edge, on plain dark wood. The subject is pressed into the wax as a deep, simple relief, like a signet impression: soft raking light from the upper left, matte wax, no shine. Only the seal, its relief and the wood.

miniature.name: Миниатюра рукописи
miniature.text: Style: a medieval illuminated-manuscript miniature. Flat matte colours from a small earthy palette: ochre, umber, faded vermilion, dull green, bone white, outlined in confident dark-brown ink. Plain worn vellum background, no gold, no decoration around the subject, no perspective tricks.

silhouette.name: Силуэт тушью
silhouette.text: Style: a solid black ink silhouette, like a cut-paper shadow, on plain aged parchment. Almost no interior lines: the shapes are read from their outline alone. A thin ground line at most. One small muted oxblood-red accent on a single detail, everything else black.

wolves.title: Волки, которых не было
wolves.text: Сказал Лотару, что перебил стаю, — и никто не узнал правду.
wolves.emblem: A small leather pouch of coins lying on a single wolf paw print pressed into mud. The red accent, if any, is the pouch's drawstring.

yield.title: Сдался и выжил
yield.text: Встал на колени перед бандитами и ушёл живым.
yield.emblem: A plain iron sword lying flat on the ground, and beside it an open, empty hand resting palm up. The red accent, if any, is a strip of cloth on the sword's grip.

returned.title: Вернул чужое
returned.text: Нашёл украденное у Торбена и вернул без награды.
returned.emblem: An outstretched hand holding out a simple pewter goblet, offering it back. The red accent, if any, is a ribbon tied around the goblet's stem.

gate.title: Слово у ворот
gate.text: Прошёл в город мимо стражи, не заплатив ни монеты, — одним словом.
gate.emblem: A heavy wooden town gate standing slightly ajar, with a guard's halberd leaning against it. The red accent, if any, is a pennant on the halberd.
